newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on long-liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on long-liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Friday, pressured by long-liquidation amid disappointment that rumoured rubber deals between China and Thailand are not likely to materialise, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.4 yen to 2.1 yen per kg lower. Benchmark November was off 1.4 yen at 135.8 yen.

Prices edged lower during the day, with few bullish factors in sight. "Sentiment turned bearish after the spot June broke below psychological support at 130 yen per kg," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
